title: Recursive Fibonacci Function
author: Aman Samriya
summary_layman: This function calculates a number from the Fibonacci sequence, where each number is the sum of the previous two numbers (0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ...).
step_by_step: Function fib takes a number n as input
If n is 0 or 1, return n directly (base case)
Return the sum of those two recursive results
analogy: Imagine asking two younger siblings to tell you a number, and they ask their younger siblings, until someone knows the answer directly.
what_it_delivers: Computes the Nth Fibonacci number using simple recursion. Useful for teaching recursion concepts.
edge_cases: Very large n causes deep recursion and slowness
summary_final: A clean but inefficient recursive Fibonacci implementation, ideal for learning but unsuitable for production.
